map.添加多个日程时间段，自动检测时间冲突并可视化时间轴: Add multiple schedule time ranges, automatically detect time conflicts and visualise a timeline
map.📖 查看「会议冲突检测 使用指南」: 📖 View the User Guide for Meeting Conflict Detection
map.把多名同事的日程（名称、时间）汇总后检测撞车，提前发出冲突预警，便于改期或委派他: Aggregate several colleagues' schedules (name, time) and detect clashes, issuing a conflict alert in advance to ease rescheduling or delegation.
map.同一会议室被多场会议申请时，用工具核对时间轴，标出资源争用时段并分配优先级。: When one meeting room is requested by multiple meetings, use the tool to check the timeline, mark resource-contention periods and assign priority.
map.混合'现场 + 远程'排期时，检测同一主持人的线下会与线上会是否重叠，避免分身。: When mixing on-site + remote scheduling, check whether the same host's offline and online meetings overlap, avoiding double-booking the host.
map.同一主持人的两场日程撞车: Two schedules of the same host clash
map.录入日程：需求评审 周三 14:00-15:00、迭代规划 周三 14:30-1: Enter schedules: Requirements Review Wed 14:00-15:00, Iteration Planning Wed 14:30-15:30, Stand-up Thu 09:30-09:45. The tool finds Requirements Review and Iteration Planning overlap at 14:30-15:00, warns the same host cannot attend both, and suggests delaying Iteration Planning by 30 minutes or offsetting it from Requirements Review.
map.两者都做时间区间重叠判定，侧重点不同：本工具偏向'日程/人员'维度的撞车预警与改: Both judge time-interval overlaps but with different emphasis: this tool leans toward schedule/person clash alerts and rescheduling advice, while the other leans toward date-based meeting-room and time-slot detection. Pick either by preference; the conclusions are consistent.
map.检测出冲突后怎么处理？: What to do after a conflict is detected?
map.优先调整低优先级会议时间，或变更主持人/ venue；若必须并行，拆分会场或改为: Prioritise adjusting the lower-priority meeting's time, or change the host/venue; if parallel sessions are unavoidable, split venues or switch to an asynchronous review. The tool only provides a conflict list and suggestions; the final schedule is confirmed by the meeting organiser.
map.会议冲突检测是一款商业办公领域的在线工具。商业办公工具，提升工作效率，数据本地处: Meeting Conflict Detection is an online tool in the business-office domain. Business-office tools boost work efficiency, with data processed locally to protect privacy.
